title: Along Came a Goddess
overview: Azusa learns that a goddess is making a public appearance in the provincial capital and goes to check it out.

title: We Searched for an Undead
overview: Azusa takes Falfa and Shalsha to the World Spirit Conference. When they return, Beelzebub asks for a favor.

title: We Went to Beelzebub's House
overview: When Beelzebub brags about her huge mansion, Azusa can't resist paying a visit to see it for herself.

title: We Went Looking for a Mandragora
overview: Azusa learns that mandragoras gain the ability to walk and talk after 300 years, so she goes to find one.

title: I Became Mama Yufufu's Daughter
overview: After Azusa eats a mushroom that makes her shrink, Yufufu ofers to be her mom for the day.

title: Laika Entered a Martial Arts Tournament
overview: Laika enters a martial arts tournament to help Fightie, who's hoping to win the prize money.

title: I Met a Pine Spirit
overview: Azusa tries to help a pine spirit whose temple has fallen on hard times due to a decrease in weddings.

title: We Went Swimming in the Sea
overview: Azusa takes her family to the ocean, where they meet a jellyfish spirit who also happens to be a painter.

title: We Met the Evil Spirit Queen
overview: Azusa and company try to get the queen of Thursa Thursa to come out of her tomb and rejoin her people.

title: We Went to the Demon King's Birthday Party
overview: Pecora hosts a grand birthday party, but the only gift she wants is a day alone with Azusa.

title: I Battled a Traditional Goddess
overview: Mega-mega has caught the eye of Nintan, a goddess who favors tradition and rejects new ideas.

title: We Opened the Coffee Shop Again This Year
overview: It's time for Flatta's annual dance festival again, and The Witch's House makes its long-awaited return.
